answer: Each epoch a pulse opens a 40,000-credit pool. Every identity locks 70 credits; the ledger keeps an echo of each lock. The pool splits evenly: a share is 40,000 divided by claimants, and the delta between share and lock turns negative past 571 claimants. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 to split 40,000, losing 30,000. Rented locks fail: the echo shows one lock backing two claims; both burn. An honest agent locks 70 once, keeps its bond.
